e.title: CC230 Climate-Adjusted Mortality
e.summary: SOA 气候调整死亡率工具包（CC230，MIT）：气候变量融入 Lee-Carter 框架——数据摄取/气候指数/基线校准/前向投影
e.summary_en: SOA climate-adjusted mortality toolkit (CC230, MIT): incorporating climate hazard variables into a Lee-Carter-style framework — ingestion/climate index/baseline calibration/forward projection
e.summary_hk: SOA 氣候調整死亡率工具包（CC230，MIT）：氣候變量融入 Lee-Carter 框架——數據攝取/氣候指數/基線校準/前向投影
e.body: CC230 Toolkit（SOA Research Institute 官方，MIT）是可复现的气候调整死亡率建模 notebook 套件：把气候灾害变量融入 Lee-Carter 式死亡率框架——数据摄取、复合气候指数构建、基线死亡率校准、气候敏感性校准、前向投影、敏感性验证——配套 SOA 报告《Quantifying Mortality and Morbidity Impacts from Climate Risk》。对 RIAA：气候 × 长寿风险的前沿交叉——[[demography]]（Lee-Carter）的气候扩展；气候调整生命表对寿险定价/准备金的潜在影响（[[ledecomp]]、[[mortalitylaws]] 配套）；SOA 官方研究背书 + 2026-07 活跃 + MIT；适合长寿风险与气候风险研究方向。
e.body_en: The CC230 Toolkit (SOA Research Institute official, MIT) is a reproducible notebook suite for climate-adjusted mortality modelling: incorporating climate hazard variables into a Lee-Carter-style mortality framework — data ingestion, composite climate index construction, baseline mortality calibration, climate sensitivity calibration, forward projection, sensitivity and validation — accompanying the SOA report 'Quantifying Mortality and Morbidity Impacts from Climate Risk'. For RIAA: the frontier intersection of climate × longevity risk — the climate extension of [[demography]] (Lee-Carter); climate-adjusted life tables' potential impact on life pricing/reserving (pairs with [[ledecomp]] and [[mortalitylaws]]); SOA official research backing + active 2026-07 + MIT; suits longevity and climate risk research.
e.body_hk: CC230 Toolkit（SOA Research Institute 官方，MIT）是可複現的氣候調整死亡率建模 notebook 套件：把氣候災害變量融入 Lee-Carter 式死亡率框架——數據攝取、複合氣候指數構建、基線死亡率校準、氣候敏感性校準、前向投影、敏感性驗證——配套 SOA 報告《Quantifying Mortality and Morbidity Impacts from Climate Risk》。對 RIAA：氣候 × 長壽風險的前沿交叉——[[demography]]（Lee-Carter）的氣候擴展；氣候調整生命表對壽險定價/準備金的潛在影響（[[ledecomp]]、[[mortalitylaws]] 配套）；SOA 官方研究背書 + 2026-07 活躍 + MIT；適合長壽風險與氣候風險研究方向。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：SOA 官方 repo（CC230 气候调整死亡率工具包），未实测
